selection_metric: Pooled WAPE across all three validation windows and all selected products; preserved original family after documented ingestion correction

candidate_settings.hw_weekly: Additive weekly seasonality, no trend; optimized coefficients; use_brute=False
candidate_settings.hw_damped_weekly: Additive weekly seasonality and damped additive trend; optimized coefficients; use_brute=False

failure_policy: Any exception, nonfinite forecast or optimizer failure falls back to seasonal naive, recorded in model_events.json. Other warnings are retained with predictions.
ingestion_correction: Model family preserved from first validation-only selection; see correction_record.json. The final-test outcomes were already observed before correcting cross-sheet ingestion duplication.
